description:
Artist Unknown
Hand-Carved Folk Art Mask Collection
Hand-Carved Wood with Pigment and Fiber
Multiple Dimensions (Large mask approx. 20" H)
Unsigned (One bears Indonesian export label)
This eclectic collection features three distinct hand-carved wooden wall masks, each showcasing different folk art traditions and motifs. The largest piece is a dark-stained Indonesian mask featuring a raised lizard or salamander on the forehead. The second mask depicts a characterful male face with a mustache, beard, and smoking pipe, while the third is a stylized horned animal mask with bold yellow and black geometric patterns and natural burlap fringe.
Hand-carved from solid wood with varying stains and painted accents
Largest mask features "Made in Indonesia" label on reverse with handwritten "RIDHO. 1"
Integrated hanging cords or loops on the reverse of each piece
Largest mask measures approximately 20 inches in height
Condition:
Good vintage condition with visible character and wear. The large mask shows some scuffing and finish loss on the lips and lizard leg as seen in close-up photos. The bull mask has fraying to the jute fringe consistent with age and material. No structural cracks or significant damage noted to the wood supports.

description:

Coloring shifts from deeper purple at the tips to pale near the base. Dimensions are estimated at roughly 5 inches long by 4 inches wide by 3 inches tall. No stand, box, or paperwork is included.

description:
MC
Sterling Silver Fountain Pen - .925 Sterling
Vintage, Single Piece
This sterling silver fountain pen features an intricate relief pattern across both the barrel and cap, demonstrating fine metalwork craftsmanship. The pen is fitted with a Sheaffer nib, marked "MADE IN USA" with a fine ("F") point designation. The combination of the artisan sterling body and the reliable Sheaffer writing system makes this a distinctive piece for collectors of fine writing instruments and vintage silver.
Hallmark "MC .925" clearly stamped on the barrel base
Material verified as sterling silver (92.5% Ag) via XRF analysis
Fitted with a Sheaffer "F" fine point nib
Total weight: 31.9 grams
Total length with cap: 5.25 inches
Condition:
Very good vintage condition with moderate tarnish present throughout, highlighting the textured design. The metal surface shows light superficial scratches consistent with age and use. The Sheaffer nib appears to be in good physical condition; however, the internal filling mechanism has not been tested with ink. No monograms present.

Enhance your historical collection with this pair of vintage clear glass insulators, classic relics from the era of telegraph and telephone lines. Each insulator displays iconic, rounded contours and subtle amber tinting, showcasing glass craftsmanship from the early-to-mid 20th century. Perfect for collectors or as unique decor, the insulators' robust construction and preserved clarity highlight both their utility and nostalgic charm. Place them on a shelf, use them as paperweights, or incorporate them into upcycled art projects for an industrial twist. These pieces come gently used, with no major chips or cracks visible, and offer a glimpse into utility history with their original patina. Shop confidently knowing these genuine insulators are excellent examples for display, conversation, and educational purposes. Add a distinctive touch to your home or office with this timeless pair a piece of everyday heritage you can hold in your hands.

Your order will be shipped within 5 business days of payment, excluding weekends and holidays. All items are shipped via FedEx. The listed weight of the item may include the shipping weight, not just the item's actual weight.

Fragile items may not be combined with others for shipping. Items marked as "non-combinable" will not be combined.
Insurance is included on shipments valued over $100.

description:
Cross
Century Series Pen and Pencil Set
Sterling Silver .925, Vintage Made in USA
This vintage Cross Century writing set features a matching ballpoint pen and mechanical pencil crafted from solid sterling silver. Known for their iconic slim profile and exceptional balance, these American-made instruments represent the height of mid-century professional elegance. The set features the classic engine-turned pinstripe pattern that has defined the Cross brand for decades.
Hallmarked sterling silver construction with vertical pinstripe engraving
Includes twist-action ballpoint pen and matching mechanical pencil
Made in the USA with "Sterling Silver" markings readable on the cap barrels
Housed in original tan velvet-lined hardshell presentation case with documentation
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition. The sterling silver bodies show a bright finish with very light surface patina consistent with age and gentle handling. Both the pen and pencil mechanisms are intact with no visible damage. The original case is structurally sound with light exterior shelf wear. Includes original guarantee card and manufacturer's care instructions.
Please Read:
All items are donated and may exhibit signs of wear, including surface dirt, discoloration, scratches, and scuffs. Glassware and dishes may display color fading, crazing, or chips. Clothing items may have loose threads or fabric pilling. The full functionality of electrical items is not guaranteed. Purses may show wear on the bottom edges, corners, and handles. Jewelry metal content and stones have not been tested unless explicitly stated, and stones have not been individually inspected. Items sold in lots have not been counted or sorted and may contain small or damaged pieces. Returns are not accepted for these items.
Please carefully review photos and descriptions prior to bidding. If you have any questions or uncertainties, please contact us by opening a customer service ticket.

When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 12 Insulator
Pressed Glass, Aqua Blue, Antique/Vintage
Authentic Hemingray No. 12 glass insulator, a classic piece of American industrial history. Produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, this model was widely used for telephone and telegraph lines during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It features the signature aqua blue glass and technical design elements common to the era's utility infrastructure.
Embossed "HEMINGRAY NO. 12" on the front skirt
Embossed "PATENT MAY 2 1893" on the reverse side
Sharp drip points along the bottom base edge designed to shed moisture
Translucent aqua blue glass with characteristic manufacturing seed bubbles and swirls
Approximately 3.75 inches tall by 3 inches wide
Condition:
Significant chip and glass loss on the bottom skirt edge as shown in photographs. Minor surface soot and mineral deposits within the interior threads and grooves. Main dome and upper wire grooves remain structurally sound. Original glass color is vibrant with no internal stress cracks.

description:
Natural Mineral and Fossil Collection
Mixed Specimen Lot with Quartz, Agate, and Orthoceras
Natural Crystal, Polished Stone, and Fossil Matrix
8" x 6" x 4" (Approximate Lot Size)
Multiple Pieces
This diverse geological collection features a prominent quartz crystal cluster as a centerpiece, showcasing natural prismatic terminations and translucent white clarity. The assembly includes a variety of mineral specimens, most notably a polished Orthoceras fossil-a prehistoric nautiloid-exhibiting clear internal chamber structures. The lot also contains vibrant dyed magenta agate slices, a geode half, and an assortment of tumbled gemstones including carnelian, tiger's eye, and amethyst points, offering a comprehensive display of lapidary and natural forms.
Significant quartz cluster featuring multiple distinct crystal points and matrix base
Polished Orthoceras fossil specimen highlighting paleobiological internal anatomy
Selection of carved and tumbled stones including star and angel motifs in various minerals
Condition:
Very good overall condition with typical geological variations. Polished pieces retain a high-gloss finish, and the dyed agate displays vibrant color saturation. The quartz cluster shows minor natural abrasions to some terminations, and the fossil matrix remains stable and well-preserved.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland
Due to our lighting, white glare lines may appear on items - This is NOT damage
If you have any questions regarding the quality or authenticity of this item or general questions regarding and item, please click Contact Seller on the item page and send us a message. We are available to answer your questions Monday through Friday, 8 am - 3:00 pm, EST.

The contrast between the polished face and the raw, unrefined exterior highlights the unique geological processes that create these treasures.
